d: China’s AI-fuelled stock market boom is unravelling. Chinese markets have lost around $2.4 trillion in six months as investors retreat from heavily valued AI and technology shares. Beijing is now stepping in: 31 securities firms and fund managers sought around $15 billion in short-term funding through a central bank swap facility. Authorities are also encouraging technology companies to buy back their shares with the help of cheaper loans, after already putting around $19 billion into exchange-traded funds. Regulators have reportedly paused major IPOs as they wait for markets to stabilise.…
